name: Numerical Methods
description: Computing with real numbers on real machines: error, root finding, linear systems, interpolation, integration and ODEs.

nodes.name: Floating point
nodes.desc: How IEEE 754 numbers are stored, machine epsilon and rounding.

nodes.name: Error analysis
nodes.desc: Truncation versus rounding error, error propagation and cancellation.

nodes.name: Conditioning
nodes.desc: Condition numbers and the difference between a hard problem and an unstable algorithm.

nodes.name: Root finding
nodes.desc: Bisection, Newton's method, the secant method and convergence rates.

nodes.name: Direct solvers
nodes.desc: LU factorisation with pivoting and Cholesky for linear systems.

nodes.name: Iterative solvers
nodes.desc: Jacobi, Gauss-Seidel and conjugate gradient methods.

nodes.name: Least squares
nodes.desc: Normal equations, QR factorisation and fitting data.

nodes.name: Eigenvalue methods
nodes.desc: Power iteration, inverse iteration and the QR algorithm.

nodes.name: Interpolation
nodes.desc: Lagrange and Newton polynomials and Runge's phenomenon.

nodes.name: Splines
nodes.desc: Piecewise polynomial and cubic spline interpolation.

nodes.name: Numerical derivatives
nodes.desc: Finite difference formulas and choosing the step size.

nodes.name: Numerical integration
nodes.desc: Trapezoidal, Simpson's and Gaussian quadrature rules.

nodes.name: Numerics toolkit
nodes.desc: Implement and test solvers, fitting and quadrature, comparing accuracy against known results.

nodes.name: Euler's method
nodes.desc: Explicit and implicit Euler for initial value problems.

nodes.name: Runge-Kutta
nodes.desc: RK4, adaptive step sizes and error control.

nodes.name: Stiff equations
nodes.desc: Why some ODEs need implicit methods and stability regions.

nodes.name: Finite differences
nodes.desc: Discretising PDEs such as the heat equation on a grid.

nodes.name: Optimisation methods
nodes.desc: Gradient descent, Newton and quasi-Newton methods for minimisation.

nodes.name: Sparse matrices
nodes.desc: Sparse storage formats and solving large sparse systems.

nodes.name: Monte Carlo methods
nodes.desc: Random sampling for integration and simulation, and variance reduction.

nodes.name: Physics simulation
nodes.desc: Simulate a physical system such as orbits or heat flow and check energy and error behaviour.
